description: Day-over-day open-interest deltas: per-contract OI changes, top-N sorted by absolute magnitude, and call/put aggregate totals. Use to track new positioning, unwinding, and block print intent from OI shifts.

apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key. Omit when calling via /mcp-oauth (OAuth flow); required on /mcp.

topN.description: Optional top-N results to return (default 10, clamped to 1-100).
